titles.romaji: Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori: Zekkouchou!
titles.native: まじめにふまじめ かいけつゾロリ ゼッコーチョー！

description: The second season of Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori. Rather than adapting the storybooks, this season focuses on an anime original arc of Puppe's search for the Minus Eel and Zorori's battle with The Legendary Prank King.
